issue_context.title: Missing a method to insert related entities at a specific index (`insert_children`)

review_comments: This does not update the other side of the relationship (`ChildOf`), invalidating the assumptions of the system as a whole.
What happens if the entity is already a child? As a user, I'd like to know whether that is okay ok or not. For example, does doing so reorder it?
Is it possible to change the return to Bevy Result and then return `Err()` here?
